name: keka
description: Keka-equivalent HR & Payroll platform — multi-tenant HRMS with Indian statutory payroll

scripts.build: npm run generate --workspace=@keka/db && npm run build --workspace=@keka/web
scripts.test: tsx --test packages/payroll/test/*.test.ts packages/time/test/*.test.ts packages/rbac/test/*.test.ts packages/documents/test/*.test.ts packages/services/test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/rbac && tsc -p packages/time && tsc -p packages/documents && tsc -p packages/services && node --max-old-space-size=6144 node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/web
scripts.test:smoke: for s in smoke-seams smoke-crud smoke-employee smoke-payroll-config smoke-time smoke-time-ui smoke-lifecycle smoke-loans smoke-auth smoke-filings smoke-performance smoke-hiring smoke-expenses smoke-projects smoke-accounting smoke-self-service smoke-engage-learn smoke-probation smoke-roles smoke-import smoke-custom-fields smoke-workplace-settings smoke-leave-year-end smoke-tax-proofs smoke-bonuses smoke-fbp smoke-perks smoke-off-cycle smoke-approvals smoke-payroll-reports smoke-roster smoke-overtime smoke-punch-api smoke-geo-clock smoke-careers smoke-preboarding smoke-letters smoke-feedback-360 smoke-one-on-ones smoke-review-to-pay smoke-webhooks smoke-report-builder smoke-dashboards smoke-resource-planner smoke-sso smoke-finances smoke-asset-pages smoke-isolation; do echo "\n### $s"; tsx scripts/$s.ts || exit 1; done
